Name: Agent Vitals
Author: Cristiano Tapparello
Description: Live Claude usage limits, running Claude Code sessions, and quick-launch keys for Claude Desktop.

Actions.Name: Session Usage (5h)
Actions.Tooltip: 5-hour usage: the subscription session limit, or local spend over the last 5 hours on accounts without one (Foundry/Bedrock/Vertex). Set a budget to get a ring. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Weekly Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Weekly usage: the subscription weekly limit, or local spend over the last 7 days on accounts without one. Set a budget to get a ring. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Active Sessions
Actions.Tooltip: Running Claude Code sessions. Press to cycle through session details.

Actions.Name: Today's Activity
Actions.Tooltip: Today's Claude Code activity: chats, messages, and tokens. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Launch Claude Desktop
Actions.Tooltip: Open the Claude Desktop app.

Actions.Name: Claude Quick Chat
Actions.Tooltip: Trigger Claude's quick-chat hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+Space on Windows; set your hotkey in settings on macOS).

Actions.Name: Open claude.ai
Actions.Tooltip: Open a new chat on claude.ai in your browser.

Actions.Name: Claude Code Terminal
Actions.Tooltip: Open a terminal running Claude Code in your GitHub folder.

Actions.Name: Model Usage (weekly)
Actions.Tooltip: Per-model usage: the subscription weekly per-model limit, or local 7-day spend per model on accounts without one. Pick the model in settings.

Actions.Name: Burn Rate
Actions.Tooltip: Tokens per hour over the last hour, plus estimated time until the 5h session cap.

Actions.Name: Project Terminal
Actions.Tooltip: Open Claude Code in a specific project folder. Configure the folder in settings.

Actions.Name: Focus Session
Actions.Tooltip: Press to cycle through running Claude Code sessions and bring their window to the front.

Actions.Name: Quick Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Open Claude quick chat and paste a canned prompt. Configure the prompt in settings.

Actions.Name: Claude Custom
Actions.Tooltip: A Claude-styled key that opens anything you choose: app, URL, or folder.

Actions.Name: Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Local Claude Code token volume + estimated cost for a time window. Press to toggle cost/tokens; pick the window in settings.

Actions.Name: Claude Status
Actions.Tooltip: Live state of a Claude Code session: Needs approval / Input needed / Working / Finished / Idle. Bind to a project in settings, or leave blank to auto-track the session that needs you.

Actions.Name: Claude Waiting
Actions.Tooltip: Lights up when any Claude Code session is waiting on you (permission prompt or question). Press to jump to that session's window; press again to cycle if several are waiting.

Actions.Name: Claude Allow
Actions.Tooltip: Approve the pending Claude Code permission prompt (same as pressing 1 in the terminal). Shows the command it would allow. Needs the one-time hook setup in this key's settings.

Actions.Name: Claude Always Allow
Actions.Tooltip: Approve and stop asking, using Claude Code's own suggested rule (same as pressing 2 in the terminal). The key shows the rule it would save. Greys out when no safe rule is offered.

Actions.Name: Claude Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Refuse the pending Claude Code permission prompt (same as pressing 3 in the terminal). The turn continues and Claude adapts.
